resources.string: Keeps notification code detection available and reports its health.
Accessibility notification events are connected; the standard listener is disconnected
Notification access is disabled; tap Repair
Permission is enabled, but the listener is disconnected; tap Repair

Aggressive firmware can disconnect notification access even after the standard permissions are granted. The foreground service, listener rebind heartbeat, WorkManager watchdog and Alarm recovery are the supported resilience paths.
On HONOR MagicOS, also open Recents and swipe down on the OTP Helper card until the lock icon appears. OTP Helper is no longer hidden from Recents.

Reads only Android notification accessibility events to detect one-time codes. It does not inspect windows, perform gestures, read key input, or take screenshots. While the device is locked, Android may provide only the notification public version.
Enable notification reading through Accessibility events

Optional second notification-reading path defined by Android's public Accessibility API. Android 16 still exposes TYPE_NOTIFICATION_STATE_CHANGED and its Notification parcelable. For a locked device, a non-public notification may be replaced with its public version. This service requests no window content, gestures, key events, or screenshots.

Generate a redacted diagnostic report containing current permissions, actual notification-listener and Accessibility notification-event connections, service state, watchdog state, device information and recent OTP Helper logs.
